artists.biography: 1) Austin-based synth band which is officially stylized as S U R V I V E 2) Japanese metal/hardcore band 1) Adam Jones, Kyle Dixon, Mark Donica, Michael Stein form the analog synth purist band SURVIVE, considered as one of Austin's most important live electronic mainstays. With Austin's diverse underground synth scene starting to boil over (see: Neon Indian's world domination, Silent Diane's new single on Matador imprint True Panther, //TENSE// early EBM shocks and Sleep ∞ Over's debut on Hippos In Tanks), SURVIVE is creeping up, not far behind. 2) SURVIVE is a japanese Metal/Hardcore band formed in Kashiwa, Japan in 1998. They've released 5 albums so far. perplexity.description:
RR7349, released in 2016 by the Texas-based electronic band Survive, is a defining work in the group's discography and a standout entry in the synth-driven electronic genre. The album features a blend of analog synthesizers, pulsing rhythms, and atmospheric textures, creating a sound that is both retro and forward-looking. Tracks like "A.H.B.," "High Rise," and "Wardenclyffe" showcase the band's mastery of mood and tension, with each piece unfolding through layered sequences and evocative melodies. The album's style draws heavily from 1980s synthwave and krautrock influences, but with a modern, immersive production that sets it apart from mere nostalgia.

RR7349 marked Survive's first full-length release on Relapse Records and is widely regarded as their most accomplished album to date. It solidified their reputation beyond their earlier underground cassette and vinyl releases, bringing their sound to a broader audience. The album received critical acclaim for its cohesive atmosphere and technical precision, with reviewers praising its ability to balance accessibility with experimental depth. Its success also coincided with the band's rising profile due to their work on the soundtrack for the popular Netflix series Stranger Things, further cementing RR7349 as a pivotal release in both Survive's career and the broader landscape of contemporary electronic music.
